table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	documentcode = 'SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SALELEDGER.SaleInvCode))),
		invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
         date        = dbo.saleledger.date,    
         flatdisc    = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
			salestax    = dbo.saleledger.salestax,       
         misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
			invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,
			invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1 ,
			doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
         dbo.accounts.name, 
         amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.saleprice), 2),    
			itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc)), 2),    
    		invdiscpercvalue = Sum (Round( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100),
			itemsalestax = Sum (Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * dbo.saledetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (dbo.saledetail.looseqty * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - dbo.saledetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.saledetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
			salesman = dbo.users.username,
			Discount = Round(Sum (( dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)) + (dbo.saledetail.looseqty  * dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc)), 2)+
				Sum (Round( dbo.saledetail.looseqty   * (dbo.saledetail.saleprice  - dbo.saledetail.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (dbo.saledetail.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100) + 
				dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,
			dbo.accounts.AliasName, 
			headerno=max(dbo.saleledger.headerno)

    FROM dbo.saleledger, 
         dbo.saledetail,   
         dbo.accounts,
			dbo.users  

   WHERE ( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode ) and  
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
			( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode )and  
     	   ( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            

GROUP BY dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
			dbo.saleledger.date,   
			dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
			dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
		   dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
			dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
			dbo.accounts.name,
			dbo.accounts.AliasName,
			dbo.users.username 
     
UNION ALL

  SELECT 
	documentcode = 'SV-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SALELEDGER.SaleInvCode))),
		invcode     = dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,    
         date        = dbo.saleledger.date,    
         flatdisc    = dbo.saleledger.flatdisc, 
			salestax    = dbo.saleledger.salestax,       
         misccharges = dbo.saleledger.misccharges, 
			invdiscperc = dbo.saleledger.discperc,
			invgstperc1 = dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1 ,
			doctype = Case dbo.saleledger.salecatcode When 1 Then 'Cash' When 2 Then 'Credit' Else 'Cash' End, 
         dbo.accounts.name, 
         amount =  Round(Sum ( sd.looseqty * sd.saleprice), 2),    
			itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum (( sd.looseqty  * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * .01)) + (sd.looseqty  * sd.itemflatdisc)), 2),    
    		invdiscpercvalue = Sum (Round( sd.looseqty   * (sd.saleprice  - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (sd.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100),
			itemsalestax = Sum (Round (sd.looseqty * sd.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (sd.looseqty * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc ) * (1 - sd.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * sd.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
			salesman = dbo.users.username,
			Discount = Round(Sum (( sd.looseqty  * (sd.saleprice - sd.itemflatdisc) * (sd.discperc * .01)) + (sd.looseqty  * sd.itemflatdisc)), 2)+
				Sum (Round( sd.looseqty   * (sd.saleprice  - sd.itemflatdisc) * (1 - (sd.discperc * .01)),2)) * (dbo.saleledger.discperc /100) + 
				dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,
			dbo.accounts.AliasName,
			headerno=max(dbo.saleledger.headerno)

    FROM dbo.saleledger, 
         dbo.saleinvdetail sd,  
         dbo.accounts,
			dbo.users  

   WHERE ( DBO.SaleLedger.impactinventory = 'N' ) AND 
			( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = sd.saleinvcode ) and  
         ( dbo.saleledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and  
			( dbo.saleledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode )and  
     	   ( dbo.saleledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            

GROUP BY dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
			dbo.saleledger.date,   
			dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
         dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.saleledger.discperc,  
			dbo.saleledger.salestax, 
		   dbo.saleledger.invgstperc1,
			dbo.saleledger.salecatcode, 
			dbo.accounts.name,
			dbo.accounts.AliasName,
			dbo.users.username 
     
UNION ALL

 SELECT 
		documentcode = 'SR-' + RTRIM(LTRIM(CONVERT(CHAR(7), SRLedger.SRInvCode))),
		invcode     = dbo.srledger.srinvcode,    
         date        = dbo.srledger.date,    
         flatdisc    = dbo.srledger.flatdisc, 
			salestax    = dbo.srledger.salestax,       
         misccharges = dbo.srledger.misccharges, 
			invdiscperc = dbo.srledger.discperc, 
			invgstperc1 = dbo.srledger.invgstperc1,
			doctype = Case dbo.srledger.srcatcode When 6 Then 'Cash-R' When 7 Then 'Credit-R' Else 'Cash-R' End, 
         dbo.accounts.name, 
         amount =  Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice), 2),    
			itemdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty  * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01)), 2),    
    		invdiscpercvalue = Round(Sum ( (dbo.srdetail.looseqty  ) * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01))) * (dbo.srledger.discperc /100), 2)     ,
			itemsalestax = Sum (Round (dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.unitsalestax + Round ( Round ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - dbo.srdetail.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) * dbo.srdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) ),
         salesman = dbo.users.username,
			Discount = Round(Sum ( dbo.srdetail.looseqty  * dbo.srdetail.srprice * dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01), 2) +
				Sum (Round( dbo.srdetail.looseqty   * dbo.srdetail.srprice * (1 - (dbo.srdetail.discperc * .01)), 2)) * (dbo.srledger.discperc * 0.01) + 
				dbo.srledger.flatdisc,
			dbo.accounts.AliasName,
			headerno=max(dbo.srledger.headerno)

    FROM dbo.srledger, 
         dbo.srdetail,   
         dbo.accounts ,
         users 

   WHERE ( dbo.srledger.srinvcode = dbo.srdetail.srinvcode ) and  
         ( dbo.srledger.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode )and 
         ( dbo.srledger.salesmancode = dbo.users.usercode )and  
     	   ( dbo.srledger.date between :ar_StartDate and :ar_EndDate)            

GROUP BY dbo.srledger.srinvcode,   
			dbo.srledger.date,   
			dbo.srledger.misccharges,   
         dbo.srledger.flatdisc,   
         dbo.srledger.discperc,  
			dbo.srledger.salestax, 
		   dbo.srledger.invgstperc1,
			dbo.srledger.srcatcode, 
			dbo.accounts.name ,
			dbo.accounts.AliasName,
         dbo.users.username     

    
ORDER BY		dbo.saleledger.date ,dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode ASC

objects.name: c_totalsaletaxvalue
objects.expression: if( ( doctype ="Cash-R" OR doctype ="Credit-R" OR doctype ="Retail-R")  , -1 ,  1 ) *  Round (itemsalestax  + Round( Round( amount  -  itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue   -   flatdisc  ,0) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2), 0)

objects.name: netamount
objects.expression: Round ( (amount  -   itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue  - flatdisc   +   misccharges),  0)  +  c_totaltaxval

objects.name: c_totaltaxval
objects.expression: Round (itemsalestax  + Round( Round( amount  -  itemdiscpercvalue  -  invdiscpercvalue   -   flatdisc  ,0) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2), 0)

objects.name: c_netamount
objects.expression: if( ( doctype ="Cash-R" OR doctype ="Credit-R" OR doctype ="Retail-R")  ,  netamount * (-1),  netamount  )

objects.name: c_amount
objects.expression: if ( (doctype ="Cash-R" OR doctype ="Credit-R" OR doctype ="Retail-R" )  ,  -1 ,  1  )  * amount

objects.name: c_discount
objects.expression: if ( ( doctype ="Cash-R" OR doctype ="Credit-R" OR doctype ="Retail-R")  ,  -1 ,  1 )  * discount
